title: AppsFlyer pricing | A plan for every marketing budget

facts.fact: The AppsFlyer Zero plan is free and includes a Welcome Package with 12K free conversions for the first year.
facts.quote: Zero plan includes a Welcome Package with 12K free conversions for the first year, core marketing analytics, and 30 days of access to select premium add-ons.

facts.fact: The AppsFlyer Zero plan is not suitable for apps with paid activities.
facts.quote: Not suitable for apps with paid activities

facts.fact: The AppsFlyer Growth plan is pay-as-you-go and includes a Welcome Package with 12K free conversions for the first year.
facts.quote: Growth plan includes a Welcome Package with 12K free conversions for the first year, core marketing analytics, and 30 days of access to select premium add-ons.

facts.fact: After the Welcome Package, AppsFlyer's Growth plan prices conversions at $0.07 each.
facts.quote: Following the Welcome Package, conversions are priced at $0.07 each.

facts.fact: AppsFlyer's Enterprise plan uses custom pricing rather than a published price.
The AppsFlyer Welcome Package includes 12,000 free conversions usable within the first 12 months of signing up.
facts.quote: 12,000 free conversions to be used within the first 12 months of signing up.

facts.fact: The AppsFlyer Welcome Package includes a 30-day trial of select premium add-ons, including Raw Data API Access and API Analytics Suite.
facts.quote: A 30-day trial of select premium add-ons, including:

facts.fact: AppsFlyer's Deep Linking Suite offers dynamic sync with more than 90 API partners for audience segmentation, per the vendor's own page.
AppsFlyer lists iOS 14+ and Android 12 among its supported compliance platforms.
